import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p=params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*A + p[2]*A**2 + p[3]*A**3 + p[4]*t**p[5]*A**p[6]
            + p[7]*t**p[8]*A**2 + p[9]*np.log(t)*A**3)
